sample_unit: ChatGPT-generated appeal letters (87 total rater scores)

links.outcome: Accuracy and relevance of citations in ChatGPT-generated appeal letters
links.effect: Of 96 citations, only 6 (6.3%) accurately referenced peer-reviewed sources; the rest were hallucinated (57.3%), erroneous (24%), or irrelevant (10%).

links.outcome: Hallucinated benefits and incorrect content in AI-generated appeal letters
links.effect: 51.7% of responses contained hallucinated benefits; 79.3% only partially aligned with ACI Alliance guidelines.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's baseline accuracy and hallucination rate when generating insurance appeal letters without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
